column1: # FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE (Asian release) on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# Square Enix, Unreal Engine 5.6.1 on SDK 20.5.17, update 1.0.1; 73,512 shaders, all translated. The profile is the one here as it was, no core change needed.
# The release's own languages are Korean, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese; the port picks the first one (Korean), this row asks for the Simplified Chinese.
# Tested 2026-11-13 on the Xiaomi 23117RK66C (Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, Adreno 750, Android 16): about an hour of play (two sessions, 40,000 frames), in Simplified Chinese, no crash.

# 60 fps (the profile's fps_target): frame work p50 16.7 ms, and the host's governor at 40 fps in the busiest scenes; 0 audio underruns in 200,000 callbacks; the game's own allocator runs on a host malloc
# zone (the engine's region 3.97 GB reserved, the Unreal heap 0.26 GB in use). The one red line is the window's surface format (the picture is lighter), as in Octopath Traveler 0.
